title: Moctezuma II
summary: Moctezuma II ruled the Aztecs from Tenochtitlan from 1502, when he succeeded his uncle Ahuitzotl, until his death in June 1520. Sources give his birth as 1466 or 1467. He died after the Spaniards disrupted a religious ceremony in the capital; accounts differ on whether the Spaniards or his own people killed him.

uncertainty.note: Encyclopedia.com (Gale, Oxford) gives birth in 1466; the World History Encyclopedia timeline gives 1467. Death is June 1520 in Gale and 30 June 1520 in the World History Encyclopedia timeline; Oxford says c. 1520.

as_recorded.value: In 1502 Montezuma succeeded his uncle Ahuitzotl to the throne
